features_work.sanction_delay_days: Days between recommendation date and sanction date
features_work.completion_delay_days: Days between sanction date and completion date
features_work.inactivity_gap_days: Days since latest expenditure or completion
features_work.duration_percentile: Percentile rank of execution duration within work category
features_work.estimate_variance_pct: Percentage variance between sanctioned amount and recommended amount
features_work.overrun_pct: Percentage cost overrun between expenditure amount and sanctioned amount
features_work.has_recommendation: Boolean flag indicating presence of recommendation stage
features_work.has_sanction: Boolean flag indicating presence of sanction stage
features_work.has_expenditure: Boolean flag indicating presence of expenditure stage
features_work.has_completion: Boolean flag indicating presence of completion stage
features_work.lifecycle_completeness_ratio: Completeness score from 0.25 to 1.0 based on available stages
features_work.text_length_char: Character length of work description text
features_work.text_word_count: Word count of work description text

features_transaction.amount_zscore: Z-score of transaction amount relative to category mean and std
features_transaction.amount_percentile: Percentile rank of transaction amount within category
features_transaction.expenditure_to_sanction_pct: Percentage of sanctioned amount disbursed in this transaction
features_transaction.is_round_amount: Boolean flag if amount is divisible by 10,000 or 100,000
features_transaction.days_since_sanction: Days between sanction date and disbursement date
features_transaction.days_to_completion: Days between disbursement date and completion date

features_vendor.concentration_pct: Vendor expenditure share within constituency total spend
features_vendor.work_count: Number of works awarded to vendor
features_vendor.mp_count: Number of unique MPs awarding contracts to vendor
features_vendor.avg_work_value_inr: Average disbursement per work for vendor
features_vendor.single_mp_dependence_pct: Percentage of vendor income originating from top MP

features_mp.utilisation_pct: Percentage of allocated financial limit spent
features_mp.output_per_rupee: Completed works count per ₹ 1 Crore spent
features_mp.avg_sanction_delay_days: Mean sanction delay across MP works
features_mp.category_entropy: Shannon entropy score of expenditure across work categories
features_mp.top_vendor_concentration_pct: Share of MP vendor spend awarded to top vendor
